mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a pleasant 79 degrees with mainly clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park, and the moon is currently a waxing crescent.

The Verona Senior Center is looking for volunteers to help with daily operations, requiring a two-shift monthly commitment. Volunteers must prioritize privacy, adhere to confidentiality rules, and may be subject to a criminal background check for certain roles.

Today is packed with activities, including live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead, tomorrow features the annual UGM meeting at Epic Systems and yoga classes at Insight Wellness.
The Verona Police Department reported that on August 6th, officers arrested a 49-year-old man for his fourth O W I offence after observing him driving erratically.
Today is the perfect day for a scoop of Mint Cookie. Culver's is open until 10 PM, so you have plenty of time to stop by. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor will be Caramel Peanut Buttercup.
